## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [道通](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E9%80%9A) Dàotōng — the same author as *[Tūn hǎi jí 吞海集](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0123)* (X239) — is a compact treatise on the *fǎ xiàng* 法相 ("phenomenal categories" or "characteristics of dharmas") of the *Avataṃsaka*, organised in *pán jié* 槃節 ("tortoise-joints" — i.e. articulated structural divisions modeled on the joints of a tortoise's shell).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1100 – 1280) reflects the Southern-Sòng period of Dàotōng's activity. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1013) collection, alongside its companion *[Tūn hǎi jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0123)* (X239) and *[Pī yún jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0133)* (X1014).
